title: Written counts remain in test names and comments, to be deleted for the release after 2.14.4
body:
## What

Test names and comments across the tree still carry written counts, outside the lines issues 0110 and 0111 already changed. hv's rule: a count already written down is deleted, never corrected.

## Scope

Sweep the test names and comments and delete each written count, rewording the line so it reads without one. For the release after 2.14.4. No work now.
